name: cgc-tag-page
description: Quartz 5 tag pages: stock tag-page, with the tag's description article as each page's only body. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here. Stock tag-page is the plugin this one wraps; every stock Quartz carries it, and @quartz-community/* is a shared scope the loader expects to find beside a plugin, never inside it. The body's vnodes must be the host's Preact's. The types are imported for types only.
//devDependencies: The build tool, so the build never borrows the host's toolchain (ADR-0005).

quartz.name: cgc-tag-page
quartz.description: Stock tag-page, with the tag's description article as each tag page's only body.
